page.overview:
Who is Tamra Ospenya?

She was described as having long hair streaked with gray as well as a square face.

Tamra was of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of . This is further evidence that strength is not always a factor when it comes to appointed positions.

She was thought to be fair and always just. She also seemed to be a devious manipulator.

She was raised to Amyrlin Seat from the Blue Ajah in . Her raising to the staff and stole was rumored to be the reason for the retirement of Romanda Cassin and Marith Jaen.
